answer: Each agent may earn rewards through a bridge only after locking a unique, non-transferable stake that is slashed if an independent challenge finds its operator controlling multiple identities. A prism of randomly assigned tasks makes coordinated accounts reveal shared timing and funding patterns; evidence triggers review, not automatic guilt. On a terrace of public reputation records, proven duplicates lose their stake and accrued standing. A sybil attacker must therefore risk real capital per identity and replace it after detection, making scale costly.
